name: Singapore Primary Mathematics (MOE 2021 syllabus, Standard)

source.title: Mathematics Syllabus, Primary One to Six (2021 syllabus, updated October 2025), Ministry of Education Singapore
source.section: Section 5, Content by Level (Primary One to Six; Standard Mathematics for P5 and P6)

disclaimer: Orchid is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Ministry of Education, Singapore. This mapping is Orchid's own reading of the published syllabus.

coverage_levels.full: An Orchid concept practises the outcome as the syllabus states it.
coverage_levels.partial: An Orchid concept practises part of the outcome, or practises it without the syllabus's restrictions (number range, kind of fraction, and so on). The note says which.
coverage_levels.none: Nothing in Orchid practises this outcome yet.
